info-basica:
D=/home/learner/aso/f33
uname -r > $D/kernel.txt
uname -m > $D/arquitectura.txt
hostname > $D/maquina.txt
lscpu | awk '/^CPU\(s\):/ {print $2}' > $D/cpus.txt
free -m | awk '/^Mem:/ {print $2}' > $D/memoria.txt
proc-sistema:
D=/home/learner/aso/f33
grep -m1 '^model name' /proc/cpuinfo | cut -d: -f2 | sed 's/^ *//' > $D/modelo-cpu.txt
grep -c '^processor' /proc/cpuinfo > $D/procesadores.txt
awk '/^MemTotal:/ {print $2}' /proc/meminfo > $D/memtotal.txt
cat /proc/version > $D/version.txt
grep -v '^nodev' /proc/filesystems > $D/sistemas-ficheros.txt
at: runuser -u learner -- bash -c "echo 'echo aso-at > /home/learner/aso/f33/at.txt' | at 08:00 tomorrow" 2>/dev/null
batch:
atd -l 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null
runuser -u learner -- bash -c "echo 'date > /home/learner/aso/f33/batch.txt' | batch" 2>/dev/null
for i in $(seq 30); do test -s /home/learner/aso/f33/batch.txt && break; sleep 1; done
test -s /home/learner/aso/f33/batch.txt
crontab:
printf '%s\n' '*/10 * * * * df -h > /home/learner/aso/f33/df.txt' '30 2 * * 1-5 tar czf /tmp/etc-copia.tgz /etc' '* * * * * date >> /home/learner/aso/f33/cron.txt' | crontab -u learner -
crond >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null
for i in $(seq 75); do test -s /home/learner/aso/f33/cron.txt && break; sleep 1; done
test -s /home/learner/aso/f33/cron.txt
nice-renice:
bgl() { runuser -u learner -- setsid -f "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null; }
bgl nice -n 10 sleep 3401
bgl sleep 3402
sleep 0.5
runuser -u learner -- renice -n 15 -p $(pgrep -fx 'sleep 3402') >/dev/null
ps -o pid,ni,pri,comm -C sleep > /home/learner/aso/f33/prioridades.txt
